market_education.summary_en: Markets traded in a narrow, directionless range today, with the NASDAQ slipping 0.7% and the S&P 500 roughly flat at -0.1%, reflecting a lack of major catalysts rather than any sharp risk-off move. No single headline drove the session; the tape looked more like consolidation after recent gains, with mixed breadth across sectors. No specific news items were available to cite for today's session.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅波動，方向不明，納指下跌0.7%，標普500指數則微跌0.1%，反映市場缺乏重大催化因素，而非出現明顯的risk-off走勢。今日未有單一新聞主導盤面，走勢較似是近期升市後的整固階段，各板塊表現參差。今日並無具體新聞可供引用。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like RSI in a bullish (not overbought) range, a MACD bullish crossover, price above the 20-day moving average, and a volume surge — to all line up before buying. When several signals agree, it's a stronger sign that real buying interest (not just noise) is driving the stock higher.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量確認是指在買入前，等待多個技術指標同時發出一致訊號，例如RSI處於偏好但未過熱的區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於20日均線，以及成交量明顯放大。當多項訊號同時出現，代表背後有真實的買盤動力支持股價上升，而非單純的短暫波動。
